name: Create Sales Order - Happy Path
objective: Create a new Standard Order for customer Cityscape Cycles (USCU_S14) for 10 units of E BIKE (MZ-FG-EB01), and capture the resulting Sales Order number for downstream use.
preconditions: User is authorized to create sales orders in Sales Organization 1710 / Distribution Channel 10 / Division 00; the Sold-to Party and Material are already maintained as master data.
learningObjectives: After this section you can create a Standard Order from the organizational-data dialog through to save.
After this section you can identify which fields are mandatory before the system will let you proceed to the Items tab.
After this section you can locate the system-generated Sales Order number in the confirmation message.
commonErrorsAndTips: Wrong Sales Order Type selected. Always confirm "OR – Standard Order" is selected unless the business scenario specifically calls for another type (e.g., rush order, return order); the wrong type changes pricing and delivery rules downstream.
Forgetting to click Continue after organizational data. The header screen will not appear until Sales Organization, Distribution Channel, and Division are all set and Continue is clicked.
Sold-to Party not authorized for the chosen Sales Area. The system will mark the document "Incomplete"; check the incompleteness log before proceeding to Items.
Leaving Requested Quantity blank. The line item shows a validation error and the order will not save until a quantity greater than zero is entered.
